releases.notes: 只用通用能力：录音、转写与 AI 全部走 aibox.audio + aibox.ai，本应用不再依赖宿主录音模块。转写改由 aibox.audio.transcribe 直接处理应用内录音并返回带时间戳的分段，于是原文可以点句跳转、章节能定位到真实秒数；待办 / 问答 / 文本整理也一并搬到本地模型调用，整理不再破坏原始转写。

localizedNotes.en: Now built on general capabilities only: recording, transcription and AI all run on aibox.audio + aibox.ai, so the app no longer depends on the host Voice Memos module. Transcription goes through aibox.audio.transcribe and returns timestamped segments, so the transcript is tap-to-seek and chapters land on real timecodes. Action items, Q&A and clean-up moved to on-device model calls too, and clean-up no longer destroys the original transcript.

releases.notes: 起录成功与按下停止各补一次触感反馈（与原生同序：按下就有反馈，不等落库）；起录期间锁住录音按钮，避免首次使用等授权框时二次点击拿到 aibox/busy 的假失败。

localizedNotes.en: Haptic feedback on record start and stop, matching the native ordering; the record button is locked while starting so a second tap during the first-use permission prompt no longer surfaces a bogus busy error.

releases.notes: 首个版本：应用内录音（实时滚动波形）、录音库浏览与搜索筛选、转写、AI 摘要（6 模板）/待办/章节/问答/说话人校正/翻译、Markdown/文本/SRT 导出，并对 AI 提供 7 个 memo_* 工具。

localizedNotes.en: First release: in-app recording with a live waveform, library browsing with search and filters, transcription, AI summary (6 templates), action items, chapters, Q&A, speaker correction, translation, Markdown/text/SRT export, plus 7 memo_* tools for the assistant.
